title: Beira of the Rotten Pack Boss Guide: Cold Spikes, Wolves and +10% Cold Resistance
summary: Path of Exile 2 Act 1 optional boss guide: Beira's 'Be still!', 'Feed!', 'Swell!' and 'Rotten!' cold attacks, and how the Head of the Winter Wolf grants +10% Cold Resistance.
description: Beat Beira of the Rotten Pack in PoE2 Act 1 Clearfell. Find her Frostblood Ritual site, dodge the ice spikes and wolves, and claim the Head of the Winter Wolf for +10% Cold Resistance.
author: Exile2 Guides Editorial Team

sections.title: Remember These First
sections.callout: Beira of the Rotten Pack is the Act 1 Clearfell optional boss whose kill drops the Head of the Winter Wolf — a permanent +10% Cold Resistance when consumed.
calloutDetail: Her ritual site is random but usually near the center/north of Clearfell, in a snow-covered clearing.
She is weak to Fire and resists Cold — bring Fire damage if you can.
The small circular arena punishes greed; circle the edge and respect the rune circles.

answers.text: Head of the Winter Wolf -> +10% Cold Res

sections.title: Top search questions: ritual site, Head, Cold

items.question: Where is Beira in Clearfell?
answer: Random location, typically center/north of the zone in a snow-covered ritual clearing surrounded by felled trees. Explore the middle, not just the edges.

items.question: What does the Head of the Winter Wolf do?
answer: Consuming it grants a permanent +10% Cold Resistance — a strong early-game defensive boost.

items.question: Is there a required Cold Resistance to fight her?
answer: No. She deals Cold damage but there is no fixed resist gate; the Head is the reward, not a prerequisite.

items.question: Why use Fire against Beira?
answer: She is weak to Fire and resists Cold, so Fire skills (or a Fire Elemental build) clear her faster than Cold.

steps.label: Exit the Encampment
body: Leave the Clearfell Encampment and enter the Clearfell wilderness.

steps.label: Find the ritual clearing
body: Explore toward the center/north of the zone for a snow-covered ritual clearing.

steps.label: Spot Beira's cues
body: Look for felled trees and Beira's dialogue cues ('Be still!', 'Feed!') in the chat log.

steps.label: Activate checkpoint
body: The ritual site is a small circular arena; activate the nearby checkpoint before fighting.

sections.title: Encounter Overview
paragraphs: Beira is a hag who favors Cold magic and summons wolves, using a mix of delayed spikes, frost novas and rune circles rather than a single knockout punch.
The arena is a small, circular, snow-covered space with little room to maneuver. Circle the outer edge, and never stand still inside her rune circles.
bullets: Small arena — positioning and edge-circling matter.
Wolves add pressure; clear them or body-block with minions.
Runes telegraph her Ice Spikes — don't stand in them.

sections.title: The Ritual Site Arena
paragraphs: The fight is in a compact circular clearing. Beira stays near the center where blood runes mark the ground, so the safe lane is the outer ring.
Because the space is tight, panic-rolling into a rune circle is the most common mistake — keep your rolls to the edge.
bullets: Small circular arena; hug the outer wall.
Runes glow on the ground before spikes erupt.
Checkpoint sits at the clearing edge.

phases.label: Phase 1 — Single Continuous Fight
notes: No formal phase split; difficulty rises as wolves join and she speeds up when low.

attacks.name: Be still! (AoE Spikes)
telegraph: Large magic circles conjure on the ground, exploding after a delay for heavy Cold damage.
responses: Walk or roll out of the circles before they detonate.

attacks.name: Feed! / My Pets Hunger (Wolves)
telegraph: Summons undead wolves to fight alongside her, more often when injured.
responses: Clear wolves quickly or use minions to body-block them.

attacks.name: Swell! (Frost Nova)
telegraph: After a short channel, an expanding Frost Nova dealing Cold damage.
responses: Back away or roll through as it expands.

attacks.name: Rotten! (Ice Spikes)
telegraph: Rune circles appear on the ground; ice spikes spawn shortly after.
responses: Position where runes are least dense; stay mobile.

sections.title: Reward Claim Flow — Head of the Winter Wolf to +10% Cold Res
paragraphs: On defeat Beira drops the Head of the Winter Wolf on the ground.
Pick it up and consume it from your inventory. It grants a permanent +10% Cold Resistance.
bullets: Defeat Beira -> Head drops on the ground.
One-time; shown as a permanent character bonus.

sections.title: Build Considerations
paragraphs: Beira is a positioning fight in a tiny arena. Fire damage is the cleanest lever because she resists Cold, and a build that can clear wolves (or body-block them with minions) removes her only real tempo swing.
Circle the outer edge and roll through her Frost Nova; only commit to the center to punish after her spike volleys resolve.
bullets: Circle the edge; never stand in runes.

entries.question: Head of the Winter Wolf did not grant +10% Cold Res
summary: Players report the bonus missing after consuming.
editorialAnalysis: The +10% Cold Res is a permanent character bonus on consume; check the permanent-bonus list, not the flask.
officialAnswer: Head of the Winter Wolf grants +10% Cold Resistance when consumed.

entries.question: I cannot find Beira's ritual site
summary: Players report only running the zone edges.
editorialAnalysis: The site is random but usually center/north; perimeter-only runs miss it.
officialAnswer: The ritual site is random, typically near the center/north of Clearfell.

directAnswer: Her ritual site is random but usually center/north of Clearfell in a snow clearing. Explore the middle, not just the perimeter, and listen for her dialogue cues.
Clear them fast or use minions to body-block. They appear more often once Beira is injured, so burst her before the pack grows.

problems.symptom: No Cold Res after the fight
directAnswer: The Head drops on the ground and must be picked up AND consumed from inventory for the permanent +10% Cold Resistance.
